svg.title: Collect a quote for each market
svg.desc: Partial behavior: repeat loop bodies for each item; take one arm of each if/else. The arms are alternatives, not consecutive calls. Top to bottom follows the established order claim within each body. Spacing does not represent duration. Messages do not imply blocking.
svg.text: Order: established · Within each body; if/else arms are alternatives
Spacing ≠ duration · Message ≠ blocking · Reply: dashed · Self interaction: bent arrow
Entry: established · Entry participant at left; other columns do not imply flow
